load: observed concurrent load; no waiting, pauses, rejected noisy runs or optional stopping
groups: control: identical slice uploads, bounded scheduler both sides
pacer: identical slice uploads, legacy before / bounded after
upload: bounded both sides, slice before / direct generated after
telemetry: raw gaps never clipped/excluded; original fixed-grid deadline misses retained, assigned-deadline misses and sub-half-period starts reported separately
scope: offscreen benchmark scheduling only; shader/data layout unchanged, no promise to eliminate OS preemption or competing GPU work
